title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for heart failure.

HPI
83 y/o female pt presents for f/u of chronic systolic heart failure. Pt reports feeling well overall. Denies SOB, orthopnea, or increased edema. Reports good compliance with current meds. No recent hospitalizations or acute exacerbations.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg QD
Carvedilol 6.25mg BID
Furosemide 40mg QD
Spironolactone 25mg QD

Exam
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, SpO2 96% RA, Temp 98.6F.
Gen: Alert, oriented x3, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
Ext: No pitting edema noted.

Assessment
1. Chronic systolic heart failure (HFrEF): Pt is stable. Symptoms reviewed.

Plan
1. Continue current medication regimen.
2. Follow up in 3 months for routine evaluation.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
10/14/2026
explanations: The provider addressed chronic systolic heart failure at this visit, so it is supported: I50.22.

distractors.why: Status plus a plan in the assessment supports the diagnosis.
